versions.changelog:
- Added a new test script: scripts/test_global_options_position.py.
- Updated core logic in scripts/flexus_lifecycle.py and scripts/flexus_specs_extractor.py.
- Improved SKILL.md documentation for credential usage and command-line examples.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.

- Initial release of Huawei Cloud Flexus L Server Lifecycle Management Skill (v1.0.1)
- Supports creating, renewing, and unsubscribing Flexus L server instances
- Dynamic fetching of region, image, and spec information from Huawei Cloud official documentation
- Strict security practices: enforces execution through skill actions, never exposes access keys or tokens
- Command triggers for both English and Chinese keywords related to Flexus L instance management
